themes.name: Agentic AI research
themes.description: Covers research and development related to AI agents performing tasks autonomously, including their applications, risks, and frameworks.

themes.name: AI coding assistants
themes.description: Focuses on AI tools that help developers write, review, debug, and manage code, including their impact and potential risks.

themes.name: AI research tools
themes.description: Explores AI-powered platforms and tools designed to assist researchers in various aspects of their work, from data analysis to discovery.

themes.name: AI chatbot research
themes.description: Articles discussing the use, impact, and research related to AI-powered chatbots, including their applications in various domains and user interactions.

themes.name: AI design research
themes.description: Investigates how AI is being applied to the design process, including UI/UX design, generative design, and design system development.

themes.name: AI testing automation
themes.description: Covers the use of AI to automate testing processes in software development and other fields, focusing on efficiency and reliability.

themes.name: AI summarization
themes.description: Articles about AI tools that condense large amounts of text, such as meeting transcripts, earnings calls, and research papers, into concise summaries.

themes.name: AI usability testing
themes.description: Focuses on the evaluation of AI systems and AI-powered products for their usability, including user experiences and trust.

themes.name: Synthetic users
themes.description: Discusses the creation and use of artificial or simulated users for research, testing, and training purposes in AI and other contexts.

themes.name: AI qualitative research
themes.description: Examines how AI is being used to assist with or conduct qualitative research, including interviews and thematic analysis.

note: Themes identified by analyzing articles from curated sources, Google News, HackerNews, and DEV.to this month.
